description: This file contains a JUnit test class 'MinusTest' for testing the 'Minus' binary operation implementation in the 'org.eclipse.example.calc.internal.operations' package. It verifies the perform method and the getName method of the Minus operation.

classes.name: MinusTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the Minus operation, extending AbstractOperationTest.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the BinaryOperation 'op' with an instance of 'Minus' before each test.

methods.name: testPerform
methods.description: Tests that the perform method correctly computes the subtraction, expecting -1.0 when subtracting 2.0 from 1.0.

methods.name: testGetName
methods.description: Tests that the getName method of the operation returns the string '-'.
